title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
before: Attention's quadratic cost was treated as the price of good sequence modelling.
problem: State-space models scale linearly but could not match transformers on language.
breakthrough: Make the state-space parameters input-dependent, so the model can selectively remember or forget, with a hardware-aware scan.
why: The strongest challenger to attention so far. Frontier models remain transformers, so treat this as a live parallel branch.
inherits: An open question about whether attention is the final answer.
